questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 4$ in simple quadratic equations (extended), evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
A data set recorded for simple quadratic equations (extended) consists of the four values $\{14, 18, 22, 28\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $14 + 18 + 22 + 28 = 82$, and dividing by $4$ gives $20.5$.
